quote: Mr. Pyne contributed $500.00
note: Bumpus's report to Jesup; the cheque Pyne sent on 15 July was for $750.00.

quote: Mr. Morgan stated that he thought it would be better to raise $1,500.00 and would give one-half if Mr. Pyne would raise his $500.00 to $750.00
note: Conditional on Pyne raising his subscription.

quote: Your salary will be adjusted at the rate of $75.00 per month
note: Salary rate in the instructions of 29 June 1907.

quote: The amount of money at present available for your expedition is $1,500.00, including your salary
note: 'this amount must not be exceeded except by special permission'.

quote: Sending check for $750.00 “although I did not wish to subscribe over $500.00”
note: PI summary with Pyne's own words quoted.

quote: Acknowledging check for $750
note: Assistant Treasurer's copy (PI summary).

quote: Acknowledging check for $750 from JP Morgan Jr
note: Reported to Osborn, through whom the cheque came.

quote: $250 from F.K. Sturgis, “a contribution toward the field exploration fund of your Department.”
note: To the Department's field exploration fund; the file does not say it was for the mammoth.

quote: I beg to acknowledge the receipt, through Professor Osborn, of your generous contribution of $750.00 toward the expenses of the Alaskan Mammoth Expedition.
note: Acknowledgment addressed to Morgan; the same cheque as reported to Osborn the same day.

quote: I beg to acknowledge the receipt from you of a check for $750., being the contribution of Mr. J. P. Morgan, Jr., for the Alaskan Mammoth Expedition.
note: Excerpt (#631) addressed to Osborn; the same cheque, a third attestation.

quote: Have wired one hundred and fifty. Do you need more?
note: Wired to Quackenbush at the Ranier Grande Hotel, Seattle.

quote: they thought $1,500 would be sufficient to meet the expenses of the expedition
note: Grant and Quackenbush, calling at the Museum in February 1908; the unsigned letter of 25 February 1908 repeats the estimate as 'a fund of at least $1,500'.

quote: I was authorized to give encouragement that $1,500 would be provided for this expedition
note: Bumpus, on Osborn's authority; 'to be raised, if possible, by interesting some who had not contributed in other ways'.

quote: Ticket N.Y.—Seattle $81.50
note: First line of Quackenbush's estimate of 27 March 1908.

quote: Salary @ $100 per month – 3 months –
note: Salary line of the estimate; the tabulated figure is 300.

quote: In case of crossing Seward Peninsula add $200 less $30
note: The overland alternative, costed in the estimate.

quote: a sum not to exceed $2,000 for the Alaska expedition
note: Appropriated by the Executive Committee (PI summary of Bumpus's letter).

quote: you will be permitted to draw upon the credit of the Museum to the extent of $2,000.
note: The 1908 commission; the sum includes salary.

quote: your salary while you are in the field, at $100. per month
note: Salary rate in the 1908 commission.

quote: with an order to sell the canoe—if possible—for not less than $75.00 which he is to forward to the Museum
note: The canoe left with Quinn at Keewalik; whether it was sold is not in the file.

quote: JP Morgan Jr wants to pay half the cost of LSQ’s expedition provided Percy Pyne pays the other half.
note: Undated note from Osborn to Sherwood, filed with the January 1909 letters (PI summary).

quote: Total expense 1908 was $1,712.27.
note: The Museum's statement of the 1908 cost (PI summary).

quote: would it be convenient to send a check “at an early date” for share, $856.14, payable to Mr. Charles Lanier, Treasurer.
note: The only statement of a half in figures; see finding f_1909_halves.

quote: it gives me much pleasure to bear one-half of the cost of the Expedition to Alaska in search of mammoth remains
note: Cheque enclosed; no figure in the letter as summarised.

quote: If you wish, I will go for $100 a month and expenses, as before.
note: Quackenbush to Grant on the Coffee Creek hair.

quote: not less, including Mr. Quackenbush’s salary, than $700
note: Lucas's estimate; 'I am blest if I know wher that $700 is to come from'.

quote: Paid for half of both 1907 and 1908 expeditions.
note: PI, Cast of Characters, under J.P. Morgan Jr.
